candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on words, morphemes, and proper nouns related to the Greek language, culture, and Eastern Orthodox Christianity.
This vector represents Thai vowel and tone markers used in Southeast Asian typography.
This vector activates common Thai syllable components and grammatical particles, particularly associated with words meaning "all" or "together."
This vector activates strongly for the Thai vowel sign Sara I.
This feature vector represents common Thai syllable endings and sub-word grammatical components.
This vector represents Thai words, abbreviations, and single-character consonant-vowel combinations starting with the Thai letter "อ" (Or Ang).
This vector is related to isolated alphabetic characters and short linguistic sub-word fragments across multiple writing systems.
This feature activates for Greek-related words, particularly the capital city Athens and historical terms like Corinth.
The feature vector activates on tokens related to the political figure George Dimitrov and miscellaneous Thai-script character sequences.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens containing the letters "l" and "i" or common morphological suffixes.
